answer: Send each key a private prompt at a random minute of the epoch with a 90-second reply window. An honest agent answers once. An operator with 1,000 keys faces about 17 prompts a minute arriving unpredictably, so it must buy enough parallel model capacity to write 1,000 distinct replies on time; a missed window pays zero. Prompt forms vary: write a sonnet, plan a ridge hike, critique an onyx price chart. Reply latencies go on-ledger, and keys whose timings track within 200 ms over 10 epochs are grouped to split one reward.
